title: flow_runner.py and the flow recipe format
acceptance_criteria: Build .harness/bin/flow_runner.py with validate, launch (agents and enqueue), status, gate and stop, as design section 4 specifies. Check the real Claude Code CLI flags with claude --help before coding them. HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN selects the executable; tests use a fake one that prints a scripted final result.

Recipe validation per design section 3, including the permission deny list. Ship one example recipe, .harness/flows/example-wave.json, that validates against tasks the test creates in a throwaway root (not live tasks).
Add .harness/runs/ to .gitignore. Verdicts are read back from the board. Producer names are registered before and unregistered after through session.py.
.harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py per design section 8. Edit only flow_runner.py, its test, the example recipe and .gitignore. Run only your own test file. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: Coordinator takes over: the dispatched producer stopped before writing code.
Coordinator builds this directly from design-T-484-ui.md.

HANDOFF -> verifier: flow_runner.py, the example recipe .harness/flows/example-wave.json and .harness/runs/ in .gitignore, built by the coordinator from design-T-484-ui.md (departures in its section 9: no session-holder registration, a track title creates missing tasks, statuses enqueued and finished, prompt on stdin, permission allow list that also denies bypassPermissions, per-step timeout). fast_tests.py now logs one tests_run event for the activity tooltip. Replay: python3 .harness/bin/fast_tests.py .harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py -> 28 passed; every agent step runs the fake CLI named by HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN. Full suite once by the coordinator: 1403 passed, 4 skipped.

REJECTED: the replay is green (28 passed) and three of the four requested mutants are caught, but the verdict-from-text mutant is not. The verdict test does not test what its name says.

Mutants, each in its own scratch copy under <tmp>/tmp.EegpNLK7cV (repo never edited), test file run with pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider .harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py:
- --dangerously-skip-permissions added to claude_argv: CAUGHT (13 failed, 15 passed).
- producer allowed to equal its verifier (validate check removed): CAUGHT (1 failed).
- gate skipped (drive never runs fast_tests.py, never stops at awaiting_operator): CAUGHT (3 failed).
- verdict decided from the step's result text, variant A (text mapped to a status, board status as fallback): NOT CAUGHT (28 passed).
- verdict decided from the step's result text, variant B (text only, unknown text fails the track): NOT CAUGHT (28 passed).

Why the verdict mutants survive: the fake CLI in test_flow_runner.py builds its final result text from the act it performs on the board ("did approve" only after approve sets the board to done, and so on). Text and board therefore never disagree in any test, so a verdict read from text is indistinguishable from one read from the board. test_the_verdict_comes_from_the_board_not_the_text uses a "nothing" act and passes under either mutant, because the track fails on either path.

Gap to close (test change, not a code change): a fake act whose result text disagrees with the board (for example prints "did approve" and leaves the task in review), with an assertion that the track is not marked done and the verdict equals the board status.

Code read: run_step returns _task_status (the board), and run_track branches on that return value. The code itself is correct; the defect is test coverage.

Other checks passed:
- Every agent step runs the fake named by HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN: setUp sets it in every Fixture subclass (all four test classes), and the fake logs each call's agent and argv. The 2-step test asserts exactly worker-a then verifier-a.
- No test reaches a real model: the only subprocess paths in flow_runner.py are claude_argv (env HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN, else "claude"), the detached _drive launch (tests use foreground=True), and fast_tests.py (replaced by a fake suite in the fixture). A sentinel claude on PATH that logs and exits 99 recorded zero hits across all six runs.
- Baseline in the scratch copy: 28 passed.

Board status: T-487 is returned open for the test gap. Code is not blocked.
Fixing the rejected test: a fake agent whose final text disagrees with the board.

HANDOFF -> verifier: Round 2, answering verifier-ui-runner's REJECTED note. The fake CLI now has lie_<act> actions: they leave the board untouched but print exactly the final text the honest act prints. Two new tests: a verifier that reports "did approve" without acting leaves the track failed with the board still in review; a producer that reports "did produce" without acting fails the track after one step. Coordinator check in a scratch copy: the text-verdict mutant (map "did approve" to done and "did produce" to review in run_step) now fails both tests (2 failed, 28 passed). No change to flow_runner.py itself. Also closed two gaps the T-485 verifier named, in test_console.py: tree_digest now counts directories, and a new test checks that streamed events are redacted. Replay: python3 .harness/bin/fast_tests.py .harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py .harness/tests/test_console.py -> 55 passed. T-488 was reopened (it had been marked done while T-487 was open); the board defect behind that is T-495.

VERDICT on T-487 (round 2, verifier-ui-runner-2): done. Checked against T-488's criteria.

Replay: fast_tests.py .harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py -> 30 passed.

Mutants, each in a scratch copy ($D/repo, repository not edited), one at a time, run with pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider .harness/tests/test_flow_runner.py; restored to baseline (30 passed) afterwards:
- (a) --dangerously-skip-permissions appended to claude_argv: CAUGHT (15 failed, 15 passed).
- (b) producer may equal verifier (validate check disabled): CAUGHT (1 failed, test_the_producer_cannot_be_its_own_verifier).
- (c1) verdict from step result text, board status as fallback: CAUGHT (2 failed: test_a_verifier_that_reports_approval_without_acting_is_not_done, test_a_producer_that_reports_work_without_acting_fails).
- (c2) verdict from step result text only: CAUGHT (2 failed, same two tests).
- (d) gate skipped (no fast_tests run, no awaiting_operator): CAUGHT (3 failed: test_produce_verify_done_then_the_gate_waits, test_approve_once, test_the_cli_gate_rejects).

Fake executable: every Fixture subclass (TestValidate, TestEnqueue, TestAgents, TestGateAndStop) sets HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN to the fake wrapper in setUp. All 13 launches that run agents use foreground=True; the 3 enqueue launches run no steps. No Popen or detached driver path is reached. Sentinel check: a "claude" on PATH that logs and exits 99, with HARNESS_CLAUDE_BIN unset in the parent environment: 30 passed, 0 sentinel hits.

Gaps (not blocking):
- The text-versus-board tests only check one direction (text claims a status the board does not have). No test has the board reach a status the text contradicts (for example board done, text "did reject"). A mutant that trusted the board but read text for failure reporting would not be caught by these tests.
- The gate mutant checked the gate status and the awaiting_operator stop, not the suite run itself (run_suite skipped while the gate is kept). Not run here.
